name: Admin Document Folder Panel Resize
description: Resize the /panel/documents folder sidebar: the default width (384px) fits the real longest folder names (22 characters, live inventory of 2026-08-16) untruncated even on the active font-medium row; a keyboard-accessible drag handle (role=separator) in the gap between the panel and the documents view resizes between 240px and 480px, persisting to localStorage (projectapp-documents-folder-width) on drag end; double-click resets to the default and clears the stored value; below lg the panel stacks full width, the handle does not render and the stored width does not apply.
